title: Orientation with short directed paths for a k-colourable graph
statement: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set that admits a proper colouring with $k$ colours. Then $G$ has an orientation $D$ — a digraph whose underlying graph is $G$ and in which no pair of vertices is joined by arcs in both directions — such that every directed path in $D$ (a directed walk that repeats no vertex) has length at most $k-1$, that is, passes through at most $k$ vertices.
hypotheses_covered: G is colourable with k colours
